availability.title: Availability
availability.description: Whether a persisted Tier 1 result exists for this supported current geography.

geography_release_id.title: Geography Release Id
geography_release_id.description: Current governed geography release used to validate the requested FIPS.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Stable reason when no persisted result is published; null when data is available.

data.description: The exact persisted Tier 1 result, or null when none is published.

Tier1CountyPriorityAvailability.title: Tier1CountyPriorityAvailability
Tier1CountyPriorityAvailability.description: Availability lookup that separates confirmed absence from request failure.

county_fips.title: County Fips
county_fips.description: Five-digit county FIPS for this persisted result.

priority_tier.title: Priority Tier
priority_tier.description: HIGH, MEDIUM, or LOW model-assisted surveillance review priority under the named tier policy; not disease risk. Null for NOT_ESTIMABLE.

priority_percentile.title: Priority Percentile
priority_percentile.description: Within-batch relative position among scored counties for this model and inference batch (0-100). Not a probability or comparable across batches, model versions, populations, or tier policies without a separate validation. Null for NOT_ESTIMABLE.

raw_model_score.title: Raw Model Score
raw_model_score.description: Model-native anomaly score; not a probability, incidence estimate, or clinical/disease risk. Its scale is model-specific and is not comparable across versions without validation. Null for NOT_ESTIMABLE.

evidence_sufficiency.title: Evidence Sufficiency
evidence_sufficiency.description: Input-data sufficiency state, not calibrated model confidence. NOT_ESTIMABLE is an abstention with null tier, percentile, and score; SUFFICIENT and INSUFFICIENT both require tier, percentile, and score.

model_version.title: Model Version
model_version.description: Version of the model that generated this result.

release_id.title: Release Id
release_id.description: Governed source release for this batch.

prediction_batch_version.title: Prediction Batch Version
prediction_batch_version.description: Inference batch identity defining the percentile comparison population.

tier_policy_version.title: Tier Policy Version
tier_policy_version.description: Version of the policy assigning review tiers from scored results.

generated_at_utc.title: Generated At Utc
generated_at_utc.description: UTC batch generation time, not the request time or source observation date.

Tier1CountyPriority.title: Tier1CountyPriority
Tier1CountyPriority.description: Model-assisted surveillance review priority; never disease or clinical risk.

metadata_revision_id.title: Metadata Revision Id
metadata_revision_id.description: Reviewed consumer-safe metadata revision; not private lineage.

observation_id.title: Observation Id
observation_id.description: Stable observation identity and compact provenance reference.

value.title: Value
value.description: Read with value_state and unit; null never means zero.

value_state.description: OBSERVED is nonzero; ZERO is numeric zero; MISSING/SUPPRESSED/UNAVAILABLE require null; NO_COUNTY_LINKED_RECORD retains the literal no_county_linked_record; NO_RECORDS retains CDC's No records. Neither establishes biological absence.

denominator.title: Denominator
denominator.description: Governed denominator; null means it is not supplied and must not be inferred.

source_id.title: Source Id
source_id.description: Public source resource key; distinct from lineage_source_id and dataset_id.

methodology_id.title: Methodology Id
methodology_id.description: Exact governed methodology resource ID; null when not governed.

methodology_version.title: Methodology Version
methodology_version.description: Transformation version, distinct from methodology resource version.

semantic_version.title: Semantic Version
semantic_version.description: Governed semantic contract version, separate from HTTP V1 and application version.

provenance_ref.title: Provenance Ref
provenance_ref.description: Structured observation provenance identity; not a literature citation.

source_published_at.title: Source Published At
source_published_at.description: Publisher timestamp when governed; null is not inferred freshness.

atlas_acquired_at.title: Atlas Acquired At
atlas_acquired_at.description: Atlas acquisition time when governed; distinct from source publication and processing.

atlas_processed_at.title: Atlas Processed At
atlas_processed_at.description: Atlas processing time when governed; distinct from response time.

limitations.title: Limitations
limitations.description: Governed interpretation limitations; preserve alongside values and versions.

environmental_context.description: Present only for reviewed environmental context. DECIMAL quantities may use exact numeric strings; native DOUBLE remains a JSON number.

surveillance_context.description: Only supplied through an admitted Data release/bundle and supported slice. Omitted or null carries no evidence-state, comparability or lag claim. Comparison is case-definition scope only; alignment is descriptive, not causal.

period_start.title: Period Start
period_start.description: Inclusive start of the governed observation period.

period_end.title: Period End
period_end.description: Inclusive end of the governed observation period.

geography_id.title: Geography Id
geography_id.description: FIPS string with leading zeros: five digits for counties, two for states.

GeographyIdentity.title: GeographyIdentity
GeographyIdentity.description: Stable FIPS join identity, independent of display or analysis polygons.

ValueState.title: ValueState
ValueState.description: Public V1 states, including the governed county status added by API #54.

source_id.title: Source Id
source_id.description: Public source resource key; distinct from lineage_source_id and dataset_id.

provenance_ref.title: Provenance Ref
provenance_ref.description: Structured observation provenance identity; not a literature citation.

semantic_version.title: Semantic Version
semantic_version.description: Governed semantic contract version, separate from HTTP V1 and application version.

methodology_version.title: Methodology Version
methodology_version.description: Transformation version, distinct from methodology resource version.

day_convention.title: Day Convention
day_convention.description: Publisher labeled 24-hour period, not a midnight calendar day.

source_coverage_fraction.title: Source Coverage Fraction
source_coverage_fraction.description: Monthly source-supported/legal county area; separate from daily completeness.

upstream_date_modified.title: Upstream Date Modified
upstream_date_modified.description: Upstream modification metadata; never original publication or first availability.

geometry_version.title: Geometry Version
geometry_version.description: Analysis geometry identity only; no polygons.

EnvironmentalContext.title: EnvironmentalContext
EnvironmentalContext.description: Coverage independent of value state; numeric strings preserve exact DECIMAL.

normalized_state.title: Normalized State
normalized_state.description: Data-owned county evidence state, projected without classification. Null means the older companion did not supply normalization; unknown supports no biological absence conclusion. Original publisher value remains Observation.value.

SurveillanceEvidenceContext.title: SurveillanceEvidenceContext
SurveillanceEvidenceContext.description: Data-projector evidence, never an API classification.

left_observation_id.title: Left Observation Id
left_observation_id.description: Public ID of the comparison's left input.

next_page_token.title: Next Page Token
next_page_token.description: Opaque query/release-bound continuation. Null means exhaustion; tokens may expire on restart.

response_at.title: Response At
response_at.description: UTC response construction time; not source freshness or observation time.

availability.title: Availability
availability.description: Observation selection availability, not biological presence. Omitted on other collections. An exhausted continuation remains AVAILABLE.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: No published rows after a successful initial non-CDC query; otherwise omitted.

release_id.title: Release Id
release_id.description: Current governed release actually read for this query.
